chunks: When the angels receive the souls of those who are blameless they will say: 'Peace on you. Enter Paradise as recompense for what you did.'

key_terms.تَتَوَفَّاهُمُ: They cause to die / receive the souls

ai.seo_question: What do angels say to the righteous when they die?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition of the righteous from the barzakh to eternal bliss, emphasizing that entry into Paradise is directly linked to their specific deeds and spiritual state. The angels' greeting of 'Salam' signifies not only peace but the culmination of their purification, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the interplay between faith, action, and divine mercy in the afterlife.
